failure_semantics.state_treatment_unavailable: full planned horizon retained with loss=1; never dropped from H1/H2
failure_semantics.state_algorithmic_failure: full planned horizon retained with null predictions scored as loss=1 after failure; never dropped
failure_semantics.material_parent_unavailable: both material arms retain the full horizon at loss=1; primary H3 ineligible and policy contrast zero
failure_semantics.material_no_eligible_site: both material arms deploy the same unmodified parent over the full horizon; primary H3 ineligible and policy contrast zero
failure_semantics.integrity_or_data_failure: no scientific record is admitted; repair/version before rerun

notes: F02/F05 development evidence only. H3 primary inference is conditional on eligible=true; no-eligible and unavailable records are retained for the separate policy-level estimand.
